answer: Participants commit answer hashes before a scheduled drand quicknet round; its threshold-BLS output then derives the nonce and evaluation parameters. Since the pulse is unpredictable until quorum publication, onyx, cipher, and willow task variants cannot be precomputed or farmed offline. Requiring one verified, rate-limited submission per bonded identity raises the cost of sybil swarms, while commit-reveal prevents answers being changed after the pulse.
